set.body: Purpose: bind the machine-readable validation record to the already published source and oracle commit without a self-referential digest. Acceptance criteria: start only after bd-01M031YWJZB254TEJ94YQ6534Z is published and its live remote SHA is known; generate validation/eyes4s-validation-0.1.0.json through ValidationBuildIdentity.release and ScientificValidationArtifact.generate using that exact 40-character source SHA and the committed canonical oracle files; emit canonicalJson plus one newline; require source_state=release, dirty=false, exact independent oracle SHA-256 values, and scientific digest agreement; add laws/.jvm/src/test/scala/eyes4s/laws/ScientificValidationFilesSuite.scala in the same artifact commit so the source-only hosted run is not forced to require a future file; stage exactly the validation JSON and drift suite; run the drift suite, laws JVM/Scala.js tests, full testAll/checkBoundaries, and formatting/generated-workflow gates; commit only those two paths; push non-force through the canardlapin identity; prove local HEAD, tracking ref, and live remote SHA equality; record the exact successful hosted Checks URL and separately classify the Security workflow. Close the hosted-CI bead and trust epic only after this final hosted proof.
set.title: Regenerate and publish clean scientific validation artifact
